messages:
Maya: Quick sync: prototype for a new Playground streaming pattern. Goals: less visual clutter, clear stop/regenerate, token visibility without noise, and safer prompt library inserts. Link in thread.

Aisha: Quick thoughts: move streaming chip off the left rail. Two options: small overlay on latest message (desktop) or slim banner at top of chat pane (mobile).

Sam: Overlay works if we absolutely position it and avoid layout shifts. Use transform for animations. Also throttle UI updates for high-frequency chunks.

Diego: Prefer single primary control. Show compact icon-only "Stop" in compressed view and full "Stop response" in normal. Avoid "Pause" semantics.

Noor: Accessibility: icon-only needs `aria-label`. Announce streaming state with `role=status` + `aria-live=polite`. Keep focus in composer.

Liam: Token counter: tuck into composer footer in compact mode, expand on hover/focus. Visual label: "~98 tkns"; SR label: "Approx 98 tokens used". Opt-out in settings for casual users.

Aisha: Prompt library: insert collapsed snippet (title + preview) instead of full text. Expand on click to fetch full template. Show undo toast.

Sam: Technical: snippet as id-only node, fetch on expand, debounce repeated inserts, cancel inflight on regenerate.

Diego: Microcopy: streaming indicator reads "Streaming…"; regenerate button labeled "Regenerate response" and appears after stream ends.

Maya: Next steps: Aisha iterate mocks, Sam prototype positioning & throttle, Noor test keyboard flows, Liam draft a11y checklist. Target internal review next Wed. Thanks!
